prompt.composition_elements: Vertical 9:16 24mm wide-angle selfie perspective. Seat the adult woman in a circular cedar soaking tub with her lower body submerged and her left arm extended toward the lens. Keep a neutral intense closed-mouth expression and direct eye contact. Include wet cedar grain, iron banding, snowy mountain and conifer bokeh, warm-lit wooden chalets, rising volumetric steam, water ripples, and condensation on the tub rim.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Diffuse cool twilight contrasts with soft warm chalet glow. Use pinpoint highlights on wet hair, skin, and eyes, soft ambient shadows, steam diffusion, accurate water refraction, and serene luxurious winter-spa atmosphere.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic 8K RAW-style digital capture, 24mm wide-angle selfie simulation, f/2.2 look, vertical 9:16, ray-traced water reflections, realistic submerged-body refraction, steam, skin, hair, fabric, snow, wood, and chalet textures, no UI, text, logos, or watermark.
